name: Doctor Boat Control Marine Intelligence V5.3
release_notes: Choose 1 to 4 active tugs per maneuver.
Any tug can be assigned to any securing station.
Each tug supports STOP/FOLLOW, PULL and PUSH modes.
Pull levels: Tight Line, Slow Tight Line, Half Tight Line, Full Tight Line.
Push levels: Lean On, Mini Push, Slow Push, Half Power Push, Full Power Push.
Clock positions are relative to vessel heading; 12 o'clock is dead ahead.
Center Lead Bow and Aft follow their vessel fairleads dynamically.
Tug forces affect vessel translation and rotation.
Solid training quays prevent the vessel from crossing berth boundaries.
Live HDG, SOG and ROT display added.
Slower maneuver motion and cleaner chart labels.
Mouse control retained now; command structure prepared for future voice mapping.
